caseNameFull: Washington, Mayor of Washington, D. C. v. Davis

opinions.text: C. A. D. C. Cir. [Certio-rari granted, 423 U. S. 820.] Motion of the Solicitor General for additional time for oral argument granted and 15 additional minutes allotted for that purpose. Both petitioners and private respondents allotted seven and one-half additional minutes for oral argument.
